key_points: GE Aerospace beat Q3 2026 estimates and raised full-year guidance across all metrics, signaling fundamental strength
Stock declined ~3.5-4% post-earnings as market focused on margin pressure, rising costs, cash flow concerns, and insurance segment loss
CEO emphasizes 'solid' demand and continued momentum; aerospace services backlog and pricing power remain intact
Valuation debates intensify: some see fully valued on cash flow, others view dip as buying opportunity for long-term compounder
Near-term overhang from cost inflation and cash conversion; medium-term thesis hinges on execution of raised guidance and margin recovery
